local out={} local n=0
for _,m in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
 if m:IsA('Model') and m.Name=='Villager' and n<4 then n+=1
  local parts={}
  for _,p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
   if p:IsA('BasePart') and p.Transparency<0.99 then
    local c=p.Color local tex=''
    if p:IsA('MeshPart') then tex=' tex='..tostring(p.TextureID):sub(-12) end
    local dec=p:FindFirstChildOfClass('Decal')
    if dec then tex=tex..' decal='..tostring(dec.Texture):sub(-12)..' '..dec.Face.Name end
    local dark=(c.R+c.G+c.B)<0.25
    table.insert(parts,string.format('%s%s[%d,%d,%d]%s %s sz=%.1f,%.1f,%.1f',dark and '!!' or '',p.Name,c.R*255,c.G*255,c.B*255,tex,p.Material.Name,p.Size.X,p.Size.Y,p.Size.Z))
   end
  end
  table.insert(out,'#'..n..' attrs='..tostring(m:GetAttribute('Outfit') or m:GetAttribute('Job') or '')..' :: '..table.concat(parts,' ; '))
 end
end
return 'villagers='..n..'\n'..table.concat(out,'\n'):sub(1,9000)
